body:
> Created a new function ProjectList::_update_project_translations(), which loops over every project item and updates stuff that does TTR and TTRC calls, copied from _create_project_item_control().

Note that TTRC labels don't need updating, they are handled by auto-translation system.

> This adds some code duplication, but I think that the benefit is worth it.

You can avoid it by adding `_update_project_control_translation()` method that updates single control from Item (only the relevant fields).
Duplicating code means that if anything changes in the control, the code would need to be updated in multiple places, which can easily lead to bugs. The "keep synced" comments are an ugly workaround that'd be better avoided unless absolutely necessary.
